display_long_description:
Welcome to velocity runners, a high-energy VR movement experience where your hands are your only way to move.

Built around momentum-based locomotion, velocity runners challenges you to run, climb, leap, and glide through immersive environments using full physical motion. There are no traditional movement controls — your speed, control, and technique determine how fluid and fast you become.

Engage in competitive tag-style gameplay where agility, awareness, and strategy matter just as much as movement skill. Whether you are chasing opponents or escaping pursuit, every match is dynamic, intense, and skill-driven.

Key Features:

Full hand-based movement system

Momentum-driven locomotion

Competitive multiplayer tag gameplay

Immersive environments

High skill ceiling with rewarding mastery

Easy to learn but challenging to master, velocity runners rewards precision, practice, and smart movement.

If you'd like, I can also make a more competitive-focused version or a more casual-friendly version depending on your target audience.
